verdict.rationale: MotherDuck ships Dives (natural-language generated, conversationally editable dashboards/charts/insights) and a remote MCP server for natural-language querying and visualization without SQL, both first-party documented features directly matching the story. There is some independent corroboration of the natural-language/AI features (HN reactions to Instant SQL) though not specifically for Dives; missing for 10: independent hands-on validation of Dives' quality/accuracy and broader third-party reviews of AI-insight generation.
